title: Concept: Container base image is not pinned in dockerfile — review required
description: In dockerfile, the base image reference floats: either it uses the latest tag or it leaves the tag off and inherits latest by default. Rebuilding the same commit can then pull a different filesystem with different packages and vulnerabilities, so the artifact that was tested is not the artifact that ships. Supply-chain substitution also becomes invisible without a digest.
applicability: dockerfile container build definitions; lexical scope.
risk: Non-reproducible builds and unvetted base updates; MEDIUM severity.
